value.rationale: A precise structural departure from a natural but misleading pairwise-independence assumption: three line-family counts from a randomly translated arbitrary-length segment are pairwise independent with exactly additive variance, yet their entire count law may differ from the product model by sharp TV 4/27. This is geometrically motivated by grid-cell visitation and yields exact probabilities, sharp extremizers, and a sign-reversing third-order correction, beyond mere code or parameter substitution.
